targets.rawSql: SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS views FROM `analytics_540845828.events_*` WHERE event_name = 'page_view' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page, COUNT(*) AS views FROM `analytics_540845828.events_*` WHERE event_name = 'page_view' AND _TABLE_SUFFIX >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) GROUP BY page ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 20
